title: ThinQ cannot log in to LG account
fullDescription: Caused by expired credentials, regional account mismatch, or LG server outage.

fixSteps.title: Reset password
fixSteps.instruction: Use ThinQ app forgot password flow.

title: Appliance not discovered during pairing
fullDescription: Wi-Fi mismatch (2.4GHz required) or appliance not in pairing mode.

fixSteps.title: Put appliance in pair mode
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Wi-Fi button 3s until LED blinks.

fixSteps.title: Use 2.4GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Switch phone to 2.4GHz SSID during setup.

faq.q: Do all LG appliances support ThinQ?

title: Appliance keeps losing Wi-Fi
fullDescription: Weak signal or router DHCP issues cause random disconnects.

title: ThinQ firmware update fails
fullDescription: Network or power interruption during update.

title: ThinQ server not reachable
fullDescription: LG backend outage causes app to show server error.

fixSteps.title: Wait and retry
fixSteps.instruction: Check LG status page; try after 30 min.

title: Alexa or Google can't control appliance
fullDescription: ThinQ skill for Alexa/Google may lose its link after password change.

fixSteps.title: Relink skill
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa/Google app, disable and re-enable ThinQ skill.

title: Scheduled routine didn't run
fullDescription: Routine may fail if a device is offline or time zone incorrect.

fixSteps.title: Verify device online
fixSteps.instruction: Check all devices in routine are connected.

title: ThinQ push alerts late
fullDescription: Battery optimization on phone delays push delivery.

fixSteps.title: Disable battery optimization
fixSteps.instruction: On phone, allow ThinQ to run in background.

faq.a: Both affected by OS battery policies.

title: Device pairing timed out
shortDescription: Setup took too long and aborted.
fullDescription: Pairing window is 3 minutes. Slow Wi-Fi or distance can cause timeout.

fixSteps.title: Retry near router
fixSteps.instruction: Move device closer to router and retry.

title: Matter commissioning failed
fullDescription: Matter requires a Thread border router or Wi-Fi + valid Matter fabric.

fixSteps.title: Scan fresh code
fixSteps.instruction: Factory reset device and scan the new Matter code.
